positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Over 1000+ hours of intensive programming course work including building, testing, and debugging on Django, ASP .Net, and MERN.
• 200+ hours of Fullstack in-house development on web applications and other technical projects
• Languages: Python, C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SQL
• Libraries/Frameworks/Tools: JQuery, Django, MongoDB, React, Node.js, Mongoose, ASP.NET, .NET Core, Razor, Entity Framework Core, JSON
• Programs: VSCode, MySQL Workbench (ORM Wireframe), and Postman (API Testing).

positions.title: Laboratory Assistant
positions.description:
• Specimen Collection and Processing: Collects specimens for lab testing. Has knowledge of special specimen collection and handling requirements for specific populations, eg. infants, pediatric and geriatric patients. Processes specimens for lab testing according to laboratory procedures.
• Computer Data Entry and Retrieval: Accessions specimens, retrieves information, enters results
• Other duties: Participates in Performance Improvement activities. Performs maintenance. Performs waived testing, EKG testing.
• Technical Resource: Helped resolve problems and answer pre-analytical procedural questions. Served as a frontline resource to laboratory customers. Assisted in the review and updates of laboratory procedure manuals

positions.title: Laboratory Assistant
positions.description:
•Responsible for feeding and maintaining cells.
•Prepared and implemented SOPs, test procedures and protocols.
•Obtained, processed, analyzed, and interpreted samples as needed.
•Ordered, maintained, and monitored lab instruments and supplies.
•Developed and maintained test records, summary reports and other technical documents.
